lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's eight pi minus sixteen? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 8π minus 16? Nope!

lines.text: A side four square, with a half circle inside on each side.
lines.caption: A side 4 square, with a half circle inside on each side.

lines.text: Each half circle is two pi, so all four make eight pi.
lines.caption: Each half circle is 2π, so all 4 make 8π.

lines.text: But the square is only sixteen! Each petal sits in two half circles.
lines.caption: But the square is only 16! Each petal sits in 2 half circles.

lines.text: So eight pi is the square, plus the petals one extra time.
lines.caption: So 8π is the square, plus the petals one extra time.

lines.text: Petals are eight pi minus sixteen, so shaded is thirty-two minus eight pi!
lines.caption: Petals are 8π minus 16, so shaded is 32 minus 8π!

lines.text: Eight pi minus sixteen was the trap. That's just the petals.
lines.caption: 8π minus 16 was the trap. That's just the petals.

lines.text: Did you get thirty-two minus eight pi? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 32 minus 8π? Tell me below!
